newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Rhodia-Ster still a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rhodia-Ster still a sell.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities in a report reiterated its sell petrochemical company's "disappointing" first-quarter results.

-- Caspian analyst Eric Graber-Lopez said Rhodia reported a first-quarter loss of $15.5 million, or $0.03 per share. That is about 150 percent greater than its first-quarter 1996 loss and a 14 percent improvement over fourth quarter.
-- "These earnings are particularly disappointing given that the company's sales volume continues to rise at double-digit rates," Graber-Lopez wrote.
-- He said the poor earnings continue to be driven by compressed margins, delays in completing the company's capacity expansion program and higher interest obligations from financing the expansion.
-- Rhodia Ster's common was unchanged at 0.32 reais on Monday, while its preferred was untraded at its Sept. 20, 1996, close of 0.60 reais at 1640 local/1540 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
